name: Balanced development loop
goal: Improve the project until all hard quality gates pass and the configured optimization objectives reach their targets without regressing previously healthy behavior.

qualitative.name: spec-compliance
qualitative.description: Verify code changes adhere to project specification documents (.md) and maintain clean architecture.

qualitative.name: code-quality-and-safety
qualitative.description: Verify no security risks, unhandled errors, secret leaks, or broken patterns are introduced.

qualitative.name: test-coverage-and-automation
qualitative.description: Verify project contains automated test suite covering core functionality, and all tests pass with zero failures.

qualitative.name: auto-documentation-sync
qualitative.description: Verify specification documents (CLAUDE.md, PRD.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CHANGELOG.md) are complete, accurate, and updated to reflect any code or feature additions.

quality_layers.name: Software Architecture & SOLID Layer
criteria: Enforce SOLID principles, DRY, modular component isolation, and clean error context wrapping.
Verify zero circular dependencies and clean package boundaries.

quality_layers.name: Anti-AI-Slop Clean Code Layer
criteria: Eliminate generic placeholders, low-value boilerplate, hollow code fallbacks, and redundant comments.
Verify no lazy snippet stubs or empty error swallowing blocks.

quality_layers.name: Security Auditing & OWASP Layer
criteria: Audit against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities: zero secret leaks, input validation, SQLi/XSS/SSRF prevention.
Verify safe memory handling, path sanitization, and secure dependency usage.

quality_layers.name: Refactoring & Code Smells Layer
criteria: Eliminate code smells, keep cyclomatic complexity < 10 per function, and clean variable naming.
Remove unused dead code, redundant imports, and magic constants.

quality_layers.name: Automated Testing & Verification Layer
criteria: Enforce 100% automated test suite execution with zero failing assertions.
Ensure all new features, API endpoints, or UI components are covered by unit/E2E test runners.

quality_layers.name: Performance & Memory Optimization Layer
criteria: Optimize algorithmic complexity O(N), prevent memory leaks, and optimize query/draw calls.
Verify zero blocking synchronous calls on main UI loops or event dispatchers.

quality_layers.name: UI/UX Designer Aesthetic Layer
criteria: Enforce modern web design aesthetics: curated HSL color tokens, dark mode, glassmorphism, Google Fonts, and dynamic micro-animations.
Verify responsive grid layout and interactive visual rendering excellence.

quality_layers.name: Accessibility & A11y Layer
criteria: Enforce ARIA roles, semantic HTML5 elements, keyboard navigation, and contrast ratio compliance.

quality_layers.name: Documentation & Spec Sync Layer
criteria: Verify specification documents (CLAUDE.md, PRD.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CHANGELOG.md) are complete and synchronized.

quality_layers.name: GitHub Workflow & CI/CD Layer
criteria: Enforce clean commit standards, git diff hygiene, PR descriptions, and workflow triggers.
